content:
Beyond the ongoing $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, today's 9to5Toys midday flash focuses on deals including $184 off the titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11, $130 off the aluminum GPS + Cellular version, and more starting from $299. Rare Apple keyboard and black Magic Mouse discounts (for some reason) are still going, we also have a discount on my personal favorite Anker Prime power bank (which doubles as a wall charger), but today's real accessory highlight is Nomad's big anniversary sitewide sale with rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, Find My tracking cards, Watch bands, and more. Details below.

You can now grab the new AirPods Pro 3 for nearly $50 off to kick off summer, more styles starting from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $149 (originally $179)

Back in stock: titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 now $184 off at Amazon

This deal sold out quickly yesterday, so if you're interested, don't miss out today. The Apple titanium 46mm GPS + Cellular Series 11 is once again $184 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now shipping the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular with titanium case and black sport band for $564.97 with free shipping.

This is one of the premium titanium models priced at $749. With today's (possibly brief) deal, you can grab it for $184 off, making it one of the best prices we've tracked for this model. It briefly dropped to $550 before Prime Day last month, but aside from that, this is the best deal we've tracked for this configuration.

Again, this deal is only for those who really love the titanium feel and slate colorway, because even with the discount, you're still paying a premium. However, the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup also have $100 and $130 discounts this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 (originally $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 (originally $529)

Rare Apple keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (for some reason) still live, all-time lows from $80

We of course see plenty of deals on mainstream Apple products—$50 off AirPods Pro 3, up to $130 off the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models—but Magic accessories are much rarer. However, we (for some reason) are still seeing Prime Day discounts extend to the standard Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, and the black Apple Magic Mouse.

Before these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on these Apple accessories were extremely rare, and we don't know how long they'll last.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID full-size $145 (originally $179)

All three products are at the lowest prices we've ever tracked at Amazon. The black Apple Magic Mouse hasn't been this affordable in a long time (I'm tempted to grab a backup myself), and both Magic Keyboard models are at all-time lows—the basic model has only hit this price once before, and the Touch ID version has never dropped below $158.

If you've been thinking about upgrading your Magic lineup of Apple input devices, now while these Prime Day deals are still live might be the perfect time.

Nomad's big anniversary sitewide sale officially kicks off: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, Watch bands, and more

Rare 20% off drops on Nomad's metal/glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands

There are plenty of cheaper 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands out there, but almost none match the quality and aesthetics of Nomad's latest model. They don't come cheap, but with the brand's 2026 anniversary sale officially underway, we're now tracking rare discounts on both the 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models for your entire Apple daily carry setup.

Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is now live, offering massive discounts on iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories, with deals on the Stand One and Stand One Max being among the rarest:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One $103 (originally $129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max $135 (originally $169)

What you're looking at here is Nomad's latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stand. They're 20% off right now, which may not sound like a lot, but they almost never go on sale.

We're talking about premium metal construction with serious heft, paired with a glass finish that provides an elegant, luxurious home for your Apple devices.

The only downside to this deal is that the brand-new Cosmic Orange colorway isn't included in the discount:

Rare discounts hit Nomad's Tracking Card: Apple Find My Pro model, Cosmic Orange, Google Find Hub, and more

Nomad's anniversary sale is officially live, and although there were a few hiccups with deals on the Tracking Card Pro and Air, they're now officially here. The discounts aren't huge, but they're rare price drops, with both Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions starting from $32.

Nomad Tracking Cards are absolutely some of the best in the industry, featuring wireless MagSafe charging—I never leave home without one:

  • Tracking Card Air $32 (originally $35) Apple Find My or Google Find Hub version
  • Tracking Card Pro $41 (originally $45) three colors

Nomad's Titanium Stratos Apple Watch band 20% off for the anniversary sale (rare deal)

My personal favorite display-equipped Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger is on summer sale for $70

Anker's 2026 summer sale continues with plenty of deals across their latest Prime charging devices, power banks, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stands, and more. One of the brand's portable charging products that I personally love is back at its 2026 low of $69.99—the 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank that also doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank is now shipping from Amazon for $69.99 with free shipping. Originally priced at $90, we've seen this deal pop up a few times this year, but I want to make sure you don't miss it this week because it's been the most practical portable charging device in my setup for the past year.

There are definitely more powerful power banks in the brand's latest lineup with larger battery capacity and faster charging output, but this one is incredibly practical for me. As one of the more compact options, it easily slides into my everyday carry while still offering a built-in smart display, USB-C connectivity, and enough battery life to get me through a day out or even longer.

Check out my hands-on review first.

It's also one of the few models in the lineup that can double as a wall charger. There are foldable prongs on the back of the power bank, so you can charge the internal battery while using it as a wall charger—I love this design, meaning you don't need to bring an extra device to charge it.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • This 140W 4-port charger can power your entire setup from a single wall outlet, now $35 (41% off)
  • Charge your iPhone and AirPods with this dual Qi charging desk mat, now $30 (originally $70)
  • This 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD can replace six chargers, now down to $95
  • Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger drops to Amazon all-time low of $25.50
  • Satechi's latest display-equipped ChargeView 140W desktop charger returns to Prime Day low of $80
  • Add four Matter-certified Edison bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home for under $8
  • Add premium Matter-enabled ambiance to your home with the Govee three-pack Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism, from $430
  • Grab this DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader for just $7 (47% off) while it's still available for your tech organizer
  • Rare deal brings Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand to Amazon all-time low
  • Still live: Anker's latest display-equipped 45W Nano charger now just $26 (all colors)
  • MagSafe-charged UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker now just $18
  • Strap this magnetic Apple Watch band to your wrist for $20 (save 41%)
  • Anker 10-port flat plug power strip now down to $20 at Amazon

Still live: Anker 3-port 160W smart display charger returns to Prime Day price (33% off), more from $8

In addition to ongoing discounts on Anker's display-equipped Qi2 25W smart charger and the latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging station, we're also tracking the return of their display-equipped 3-port 160W Prime charger to Prime Day pricing (33% off).

Amazon's official Anker store is now shipping their smart display 3-port Prime charger for $99.99 with free shipping.

For something that's essentially a wall charger, this price isn't cheap, but we're talking about a wall charger with a built-in smart display that delivers up to 160W of power output in a form factor "as small as an AirPods Pro 3 charging case," making it both portable and powerful enough to handle your devices.

More specifically, it can deliver up to 140W from a single USB-C port, capable of charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0% to 50% in 25 minutes.

Speaking of the smart display, it features AnkerSense View technology, letting you "monitor power output in real time on the screen, switch modes instantly, and unlock custom modes via Bluetooth through the app."
